name: Demo smoke test
description: Manually runs the golden tests for stitching, Ask the Lab, Autopsy, Recipes and the MCP server and summarizes pass or fail. User-triggered only.

then.prompt: Run these golden and end-to-end tests and summarize pass or fail for each area: stitching (npx vitest --run src/core/stitching/stitch-golden.duckdb.test.ts), Ask the Lab (npx vitest --run src/core/chat/ask-golden.duckdb.test.ts), Autopsy (npx vitest --run src/core/autopsy/autopsy-golden.duckdb.test.ts), Recipes (npx vitest --run src/core/recipes/recipes-golden.duckdb.test.ts) and the MCP server (npx vitest --run mcp/src/e2e.test.ts mcp/src/parity.duckdb.test.ts). Use a table with one row per area. For any failure, show the failing assertion and the most likely cause. Do not modify any files.
